message.content:
Overhaul Nxeon's competitor-comparison marketing pages to a premium, high-converting, logo-vs-logo layout (inspired by ultahost.com/ultahost-vs-godaddy), add competitor LOGOS, and CREATE several new comparison pages. Work ONLY in `/opt/nxeon-wt-compare` (branch feature/compare-overhaul). Commit + push when done. Do NOT run `npm run build`/`prisma`. You MAY add ONE dependency (`simple-icons`) to package.json — the staging build runs `npm install`, so it'll resolve; run `npx tsc --noEmit` to typecheck (a missing simple-icons module locally is fine — note it; it installs at build).

## Current state (read first)
- Shared layout: `components/marketing/ComparePageLayout.tsx` + `components/marketing/CompareTable.tsx`. It's honest and on-theme but plain (hero → table → choose-grid → FAQ → CTA).
- Existing pages feed it thin data files: `app/(marketing)/vps-vs-digitalocean`, `vps-vs-hostinger`, `contabo-alternative`, `hetzner-alternative`, `linode-alternative`, `ovh-alternative`, `aws-lightsail-alternative`, `vultr-alternative`. Read `vps-vs-digitalocean/page.tsx` for the data shape (`CompareRow[]`, chooseNxeon/chooseOther, faq) and `lib/vps-price-band.ts` for the DB-fed price.
- Gold standard for look/theme: homepage `app/page.tsx` + `components/marketing/PricingExplorer.tsx`. Reuse `components/marketing/primitives.tsx` + `sections.tsx` + the CSS utilities (`.card`, `grad-text`, `hero-aura`, `AmbientField`, `.btn-primary`, `tone-*`, `.eyebrow`). Geist font is already global. Real theme = navy/violet/cyan; no amber except semantic.

## The new layout (rework ComparePageLayout to this structure, à la the Ultahost page)
1. **Logo-vs-logo hero**: Nxeon logo (left) — a "vs" divider — competitor logo (right), a big "Nxeon vs {Competitor}" title (competitor in `grad-text`), the sub, primary CTA "Create your account" → /register, secondary "Migrate free" → /migrate. Include `ReviewBadges` under the hero for social proof. Wrap page in `AmbientField`.
2. **Big feature comparison table**: three columns — **Nxeon | Feature | {Competitor}** — with blue/cyan check for included, muted ✗ for absent, and text values for specs. Style it as a premium glass table (build on the existing `CompareTable` but richer). Emphasize the Nxeon column (subtle violet tint / highlighted border).
3. **"Why switch to Nxeon"** — 3 advantage cards with icons (from the page's data).
4. **Migration steps** — a 3-step "Move in free" visual (reuse copy/pattern from `/migrate` if helpful); "Free migration" positioning.
5. **Pricing** — surface real Nxeon plan cards (reuse `PricingGrid` or the same DB-fed plan cards the /vps lander uses; displayed===charged, DB-fed, NO hard-coded prices).
6. **Testimonial** — one short review (use an existing reviews component if present, else a modest illustrative quote — do NOT attribute to a real named person/company or invent specific metrics).
7. **FAQ** (keep the existing per-page FAQ) → **CtaBand** close.

## Competitor LOGOS
Create `components/marketing/CompetitorLogo.tsx`: given a competitor slug, render `/public/logos/<slug>.svg` if it exists, else the `simple-icons` SVG path for that brand (import from `simple-icons`; render its 24x24 path, tinted with `currentColor`/slate so it sits on the dark theme), else a clean styled wordmark (the competitor name in a `.card`-ish pill) as final fallback. So it always renders something professional. Nxeon's own logo = `/public/logo.png` (already exists). Add `simple-icons` to package.json dependencies (latest). Handle brands simple-icons lacks (e.g. Contabo, Cloudways, Kamatera) gracefully via the wordmark fallback.

## HONESTY / LEGAL (critical — do NOT violate)
- Every comparison row must be **truthful and defensible**. Use ✗ only for a genuine, checkable difference; otherwise use honest value text. **Never fabricate a competitor's price or falsely claim they lack a feature they have** — that's false advertising + gets Google Ads disapproved + is legally risky. Keep the Nxeon column favorable but factual (Nxeon is single-node Singapore, NVMe/ZFS, full root, per-game servers, dedicated IPv4 included, domains in-dashboard, transparent renewal pricing). Keep a brief honest "when {Competitor} is the better fit" note (the existing chooseOther content) — balanced comparisons are both more credible AND safer.
- Nxeon prices DB-fed only. First-month-free is hosting-only (don't imply it on VPS comparisons).

## CREATE new comparison pages (data files using the new layout)
Add these, each a thin page like the existing ones with truthful `CompareRow[]` + chooseNxeon/chooseOther + FAQ + metadata + canonical + `dynamic="force-dynamic"`:
- `vps-vs-godaddy` (GoDaddy), `vps-vs-bluehost` (Bluehost), `vps-vs-namecheap` (Namecheap), `vps-vs-hostgator` (HostGator), `vps-vs-cloudways` (Cloudways), `vps-vs-ionos` (IONOS), `vps-vs-kamatera` (Kamatera), `vps-vs-a2hosting` (A2 Hosting).
Keep rows generic-but-true (e.g. "Best for", "Storage: NVMe/ZFS vs their tier", "Dedicated IPv4: included vs add-on where true", "Game servers: first-class vs DIY", "Domains in dashboard", "Root access", "Pricing model") — do not invent specific competitor $ figures; use qualitative honest positioning. Also update `app/(marketing)/compare/page.tsx` (the hub) and `MarketingFooter` comparisons list to link the new pages.

## Output
`npx tsc --noEmit` (note the expected simple-icons-not-installed-locally condition if it appears — it resolves at build). Commit + push to origin/feature/compare-overhaul. Report: the new section order, the CompetitorLogo strategy + which brands use simple-icons vs wordmark, the full list of comparison pages (existing reworked + new), and confirm all comparison content is truthful/defensible + Nxeon prices DB-fed. Previews on staging before going live.

## What shipped

**New premium section order** (reworked `ComparePageLayout.tsx`, now an async server component wrapped in `AmbientField`):
1. **Logo-vs-logo hero** — Nxeon mark · "vs" · competitor mark in glass tiles, big "Nxeon vs {Competitor}" title (competitor in `grad-text`), CTAs "Create your account" → /register and "Migrate free" → /migrate, with `ReviewBadges` under it.
2. **Premium glass comparison table** — columns **Nxeon | Feature | {Competitor}**, logo-headed, Nxeon column emphasized (violet tint, cyan checks, highlighted border).
3. **"Why teams move to Nxeon"** — 3 advantage cards (icons).
4. **"Move in free"** — 3-step migration story → /migrate.
5. **Pricing** — real DB-fed `PricingGrid` (plans + live annual discount read inside the layout; no hard-coded prices).
6. **Testimonial** — one short, clearly-illustrative quote (generic archetype, no real name, no invented metrics).
7. Straight-answer **ChooseGrid** (keeps the honest "when {Competitor} is the better fit" note) → **FAQ** → **CtaBand**.

**CompetitorLogo strategy** (`components/marketing/CompetitorLogo.tsx`, server component): `/public/logos/<slug>.svg` if present → else the `simple-icons` glyph (namespace import + computed-key lookup, so an unknown/removed brand can never cause a build error — it just falls through), tinted `currentColor`/slate for the dark theme → else a clean wordmark logotype. Nxeon uses `/public/logo.png` via `slug="nxeon"`.
- **simple-icons attempted:** digitalocean, hostinger, hetzner, linode, ovh, vultr, aws, godaddy, bluehost, namecheap, hostgator, ionos, a2hosting.
- **Wordmark fallback (intentional):** contabo, cloudways, kamatera — and any of the above that a given simple-icons version doesn't carry degrade gracefully to the wordmark at runtime.

**All 16 comparison pages** feed the new layout:
- Reworked existing: vps-vs-digitalocean, vps-vs-hostinger, contabo-alternative, hetzner-alternative, linode-alternative, ovh-alternative, aws-lightsail-alternative, vultr-alternative.
- New: vps-vs-godaddy, vps-vs-bluehost, vps-vs-namecheap, vps-vs-hostgator, vps-vs-cloudways, vps-vs-ionos, vps-vs-kamatera, vps-vs-a2hosting (each thin, with truthful `CompareRow[]` + chooseNxeon/chooseOther + FAQ + metadata + canonical + `dynamic="force-dynamic"`).
- `compare/page.tsx` hub: added all 8 new cards with logos; `MarketingFooter`: added a dedicated Comparisons column linking every new page.

**Honesty/legal:** no invented competitor `$` figures — competitor pricing is qualitative ("promotional intro rates that renew higher — check the terms"); ✗-style absences only where genuinely checkable (e.g. shared-hosting tiers lacking root, Cloudways/Kamatera not being registrars); fair notes where a competitor overlaps (A2's Singapore DC, Kamatera's global zones). Every Nxeon price is DB-fed via `getVpsPriceBand()` / the live catalogue; no first-month-free implied on VPS.

**Typecheck:** `npx tsc --noEmit` reports only the expected `Cannot find module 'simple-icons'` (not installed locally — it resolves at build via `npm install`). With a temporary ambient stub for that module, tsc passes with **0 errors**, confirming the rest is clean. `simple-icons` added to `package.json` dependencies (`^13.21.0`).
